name: PaperBox
tagline: Desktop whiteboard for sketches, diagrams and maps.
note: No public releases yet. Opens the copy installed on this computer.

name: LinkedBox
tagline: Control your Windows PC from your phone: volume, media, cursor, apps, power.
note: Windows tray agent (formerly Portal Agent). Private app: unlocks with a license code.

name: LinkedBox for phone
tagline: The phone app that pairs with the LinkedBox agent.
note: Phone app: iPhone is built from Xcode (wirelessly), Android uses the APK from the releases. The launcher looks at which phone is paired. Private app: unlocks with a license code.

name: DriveBox
tagline: Disk usage dashboard: partition and folder maps, charts, temperatures.
note: Windows and macOS. On Windows it installs the portable download (no administrator rights, no installer); the Mac app is opened from this computer until a macOS release is published.

name: NodeBox
tagline: See how a Node project really works: routes, data flows and call chains.
note: No public releases yet. Opens the copy installed on this computer.
